name: Interactive Brokers public pricing pages (commissions and exchange fee tables)
access: Owner-initiated HTTPS GET of public pages on www.interactivebrokers.com, read once per verification and transcribed into config/fees with a quote; no account, key or login. Not an automated feed.

rate_limit.source: No published rate limit found. Self-imposed: at most one page every 3 s, and only when re-verifying the fee schedule (4 pages on 2026-10-23).

failure_behavior: A page that cannot be read leaves the schedule's values at their last verified retrieval date; nothing is marked verified without a quote from a page read that day. A summarising web-fetch agent received HTTP 403 on 2026-10-23; a plain HTTPS request succeeded.

datasets.description: IBKR Pro Tiered and Fixed US stock/ETF commission parameters and the third-party fee lines IBKR publishes (regulatory, exchange, clearing, pass-through), plus the NASDAQ/Island, NYSE and ARCA exchange fee tables
datasets.coverage: United States stocks and ETFs (IBKR LLC price list as published)
datasets.history_depth: Current page only; earlier values are not published
datasets.update_frequency: Unannounced; re-verify before relying on a number (the FINRA TAF fee holiday ends 2026-12-31)
datasets.availability_rule: A value is known from its retrieval date; the broker's commission report is the final fee for any fill.
datasets.rights_source: robots.txt (checked 2026-10-23) disallows only /smf/, /fluxbb/, /insights/ibtr_alerts.php, /search/ and /referral/; the pricing and fee pages are not disallowed. No website terms of use restricting automated reading were found (homepage disclosures and privacy pages reviewed 2026-10-23). The repository stores numeric fee parameters with short attributed quotes, not page copies.
datasets.rights_status: allowed for single-owner reference verification (no bulk crawling, no redistribution of page content)
